_help: Video clips shown on production cards. Videos stay on the original platform; the site only embeds them after a click.
production: must match a production title in site.json. If it doesn't, a clip-only card is added at the end of Work.
platform: instagram, youtube, facebook or x. Detected from the URL if left out.
thumbnail: a still you supply, relative to photos/ (e.g. clips/animal-kingdom-01.jpg). Never pulled from the platform. If the file is missing, a plain placeholder tile is shown.
format: 9:16, 4:5, 1:1 or 16:9. Defaults to 9:16 for reels/shorts, 4:5 for Instagram posts, 16:9 for everything else.
Clips are shown newest first (by posted date, then year, then season).
